{{External|rs|rsc=Black Mace}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black mace |image = [[File:Black mace.png]] |release = [[27 February]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (27 February 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A spiky mace. |value = 432 |weight = 1.814 |exchange = Yes |id = 1426 }} [[File:Black mace detail.png|left|120px]] A '''black mace''' is a [[melee]] [[weapon]] stronger than the [[steel mace]], requiring 10 [[Attack]] to wield. It is only obtainable in [[free-to-play]] by killing [[dark warrior]]s, from [[Clue scroll (beginner)|beginner clue scroll]]s or from [[Camdozaal Vault]] [[Lockbox (disambiguation)|lockbox]]es. [[Members]] can also loot it from bronze chests in the [[Shade Catacombs]] in the [[Shades of Mort'ton (minigame)|Shades of Mort'ton]] [[minigame]] or from level 106 [[Cyclops]] in the [[Warriors' Guild]] basement. As with most [[mace]]s, it has a [[Prayer bonus]] and like all [[black equipment]] it cannot be made from raw materials with [[Smithing]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = +8 |aslash = -2 |acrush = +16 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = +13 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = +2 |slot = weapon |speed = 4 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = Spiked |image = [[File:Black mace equipped male.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Black mace equipped female.png|140px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Spiked|speed=4|attackrange=1}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black mace}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Black mace}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The mace's [[attack speed]] has been decreased from 5 (every 3.0 seconds) to 4 (every 2.4 seconds). }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black mace detail (beta v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black mace detail (beta v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black mace detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black mace (beta v1).png|center]] |[[File:Black mace (beta v2).png|center]] |[[File:Black mace.png|center]] |- |RS2 Beta until
